items.title: OCR tool (Tesseract.js WASM)
items.detail: Image-to-text OCR running fully offline via Tesseract.js WebAssembly with bundled language data. Blocked on adding a 'file' input type to the Tool contract (src/types.ts) plus on-demand asset bundling so the offline guarantee is preserved.

items.title: Word-list tools — anagram / crossword / Scrabble
items.detail: Anagram solver, crossword helper and Scrabble scorer backed by bundled Hunspell EN + PT dictionaries. Needs lazy asset loading so the heavy dictionaries don't bloat the core offline bundle.

items.title: Registry 'file' input type
items.detail: Extend ToolInput in src/types.ts with a 'file' kind so image/text-upload tools fit the same self-registering pattern as every other tool, and the auto-generated form renders an upload control.

items.title: Per-tool SEO pages
items.detail: Turn each of the 59 tools into its own indexable page (title, meta description, canonical URL) so the suite ranks for individual tool searches — the architecture (registry + router) already supports this.

items.title: Public branding
items.detail: Flip on public-facing branding. The README notes branding is intentionally neutral for local use and the architecture is ready to enable it with no rework.

items.title: Cloudflare Pages deploy
items.detail: Publish the static frontend/dist build to Cloudflare Pages as a free public site, complementing the existing private named tunnel at cypher.quiddityinnovations.com.

items.title: Configure the cloud assistant endpoint
items.detail: The cloud assistant provider (src/assistant/cloud.ts) is implemented but cloudEndpoint is empty, so local TF-IDF mode ships. When published, set assistantMode:'cloud' + cloudEndpoint in config.json (keys stay server-side) for richer natural-language answers — no rebuild required.

items.title: Grow the local synonym map
items.detail: Expand the SYN table and STOP list in src/assistant/local.ts as more everyday phrasings are observed, so vague queries in either language reach the right tool more often.

items.title: Wire heavy/data endpoints into the FastAPI app
items.detail: api/main.py currently implements only the QI contract (/health, /version, /info) and is explicitly reserved for future server-side tools (dictionaries, large datasets). Add POST endpoints here only for tools that genuinely cannot run client-side, to preserve the offline-first design.

items.title: Reconcile legacy ECOSYSTEM CORS path
items.detail: api/main.py imports the registry from C:\QI\ECOSYSTEM; align it with the migrated C:\QIH\ecosystem location used across the rest of the QI ecosystem (it already falls back safely to localhost origins).
